# Path Guard Rails — error cases for invalid paths

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- raw/ prefix on write ---
stdin ../raw-prefix-input.md
! exec akb write raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# --- raw/ prefix on read ---
! exec akb read raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw read'

# --- raw/ prefix on delete ---
! exec akb delete raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw delete'

# --- raw/ prefix on append ---
stdin ../append-input.md
! exec akb append raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# --- .. in path on write ---
stdin ../traversal-input.md
! exec akb write ../etc/passwd.md
stderr 'must not contain'

# --- .. in path on read ---
! exec akb read ../etc/passwd.md
stderr 'must not contain'

# --- Absolute path on write ---
stdin ../absolute-input.md
! exec akb write /tmp/evil.md
stderr 'must be relative'

# --- Absolute path on read ---
! exec akb read /tmp/evil.md
stderr 'must be relative'

# --- No .md extension on write ---
stdin ../no-ext-input.md
! exec akb write mypage.txt
stderr 'must end with .md'

# --- Page not found on read ---
! exec akb read notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- Page not found on delete ---
! exec akb delete notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- Page not found on append ---
stdin ../append-input.md
! exec akb append notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- In-KB symlink pointing outside the KB ---
# A page that is a symlink out of the base is an invocation mistake too: the
# read is refused before the target is read, with the usage: prefix and the
# escaping link named. Planting the fixture needs symlink support, so the
# block runs only where the harness reports it.
[symlink] symlink kb/evil.md -> ../../outside.md
[symlink] exec bash -c 'akb read evil.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
[symlink] stdout 'akb-exit=2$'
[symlink] stderr 'usage: resolve path: path escapes the knowledge base through a symlink: '${WORK@R}'/test-kb/kb/evil\.md'
[symlink] ! stdout 'outside the base'

-- raw-prefix-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Raw Test
---
Content

-- traversal-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Traversal
---
Content

-- absolute-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Absolute
---
Content

-- no-ext-input.md --
---
type: note
title: No Extension
---
Content

-- append-input.md --
Appended content

-- outside.md --
---
type: note
title: Outside
---
content outside the base
